entities.summary: Joseph Lucien Jean Gonzague DeBlois is a Canadian former professional ice hockey right wing / centre. He featured in the 1979 Stanley Cup Final with the New York Rangers and the 1986 Stanley Cup Final with the Montreal Canadiens.
